name: Kharijite imamate of Ifriqiya
alt: Ibadi imamate of Tripolitania and Ifriqiya

predecessors.name: Fihrids
predecessors.text: Tripolitania, where the Ibadites rose under their imam al-Harith

successors.name: Abbasid Caliphate
successors.text: Ifriqiya and Tripolitania, retaken by 'an Abbasid army' in 761

successors.name: Rustamid dynasty
successors.text: Tahart (Tahert), where the Ibadi leaders driven out in 761 'founded a state... later known as the Rustamid dynasty'

ledger.x: 758: the Ibadites take Kairouan from the Sufris and found the imamate.
761: the Kharijite imamate of Ifriqiya ends; the Ibadi leaders withdraw to Tahart (later the Rustamid dynasty).

wars.name: Ibadite revolt in Tripolitania
wars.outcome: The Ibadites rise under imam al-Harith; the Fihrids reconquer Tripolitania in 752 and drive the remnants into the Jebel Nafusa.

wars.name: Kharijite conquest of Ifriqiya
wars.outcome: The Warfajuma and Sufris take Kairouan and kill Habib (757); the Ibadites retake Tripoli (757) and Kairouan (758).

wars.name: Abbasid reconquest of Ifriqiya
wars.outcome: An Abbasid army drives the Ibadite leaders out of Ifriqiya in 761; they found Tahart.

certainty.note: Neither page names a frontier; the Algerian part of the 757 shape is unverified and the Saharan edge is approximate.
